question: A 17-year-old boy is brought to the physician because of a sore throat, nonproductive cough, and bloody urine for 3 days. He has had 2 similar episodes involving a sore throat and bloody urine over the past year. His sister has systemic lupus erythematosus. His temperature is 38.1°C (100.6°F). Serum studies show a urea nitrogen concentration of 8 mg/dL and a creatinine concentration of 1.4 mg/dL. Urinalysis shows acanthocytes and red blood cell casts. Renal ultrasonography shows no abnormalities. A renal biopsy is most likely to show which of the following findings?

options.opc: Splitting of the glomerular basement membrane
options.opd: Granular deposits of IgG, IgM, and C3 complement

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Sore throat, nonproductive cough, bloody urine" -> "Episodic nature of symptoms" -> "Possible underlying systemic condition" -> 70% CHAIN: "Sister with systemic lupus erythematosus" -> "Family history of autoimmune disease" -> "Increased suspicion for autoimmune etiology" -> 80% CHAIN: "Urea nitrogen 8 mg/dL, creatinine 1.4 mg/dL" -> "Normal renal function" -> "Excluding acute kidney injury" -> 90% CHAIN: "Urinalysis showing acanthocytes, red blood cell casts" -> "Glomerular involvement" -> "Glomerulonephritis likely" -> 85% CHAIN: "Renal ultrasonography normal" -> "Excluding structural abnormalities" -> "Favoring glomerular pathology" -> 75% CHAIN: "Renal biopsy indicated" -> "Confirmatory diagnostic procedure" -> "Direct visualization of renal pathology" -> 80% CHAIN: "Renal biopsy findings" -> "Identification of specific glomerular changes" -> "Guiding treatment and prognosis" -> 85% CHAIN: "Renal biopsy most likely to show granular deposits of IgG, IgM, and C3 complement" -> "Membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis type I" -> 70%
analysis: The clinical presentation of a 17-year-old boy with sore throat, nonproductive cough, bloody urine, acanthocytes, and red blood cell casts is suggestive of IgA nephropathy, also known as Berger's disease. This is characterized by IgA mesangial deposition in the glomeruli.
